description: Stage-3 Bundle gate eval set (11 evals: 4 structural S1-S4, 4 principal-behavior P1-P4, 2 contract C1-C2, 1 proactivity PR1). The subject-under-test is a Stage-3 Bundle spoke output — the bundle rationale comment plus the created milestone description. Each eval is a prompt plus one binary typed assertion a judge or structural check evaluates against that output. Binary throughout (pass/fail judges, no numeric-scale rating); assertion types are structural (mechanically checkable) and judgment (a single binary LLM-judge call). Grounded in the Stage-3 Bundle spec (stage-03-bundle.md Phase A1-B4) and the bundle-composition doctrine. Stage-gate eval sets live under core/skills/eval-writer/evals/stage-gates/<gate>/ per ADR-067.

escape_rate.definition: escapes / gate_firings over the release-close window (per-release-close, rolling)
escape_rate.escape: a bundle-composition defect passed at Stage 3 (gate fired GO / the bundle shipped) but caught downstream (Stage 4 Planning, Stage 5 Collective Review, Stage 9 Plan Review, or Stage 13 Close) as a defect this set's assertions should have caught
escape_rate.gate_firing: one Stage-3 Bundle evaluation (one milestone bundled)
escape_rate.computation: numerator = downstream composition-defect findings citing this set's assertions (Stage-5 Reject/Adjust attributable to composition, Stage-9 NO-GO findings citing bundle composition, Stage-13 close follow-ups tagged bundle-composition escapes); denominator = milestones passing Stage-3 in the window
escape_rate.current_value: [INSUFFICIENT DATA - populate at release close; <3 firings = not yet reliable]

judge: cross-family, pinned snapshot; binary PASS/FAIL per assertion

evals.name: S1-release-class-present-valid
evals.prompt: Evaluate a Stage-3 Bundle output's created milestone description for the Release Class declaration required by Gate-3 criterion G3-10. The milestone description is the subject-under-test.
evals.expected_output: The milestone description contains a `## Release Class` H2 whose Class value is one of {routine, novel, cross-cutting, hotfix} and a non-empty Rationale sub-field.

assertions.text: The created milestone description contains a `## Release Class` H2 whose `Class:` value is one of the closed enum {routine, novel, cross-cutting, hotfix} AND a non-empty Rationale sub-field

evals.name: S2-outcome-statement-after-before
evals.prompt: Evaluate a Stage-3 Bundle output's milestone description for the Release Outcome Statement required by Gate-3 criterion G3-11 and doctrine section 7. The milestone description is the subject-under-test.
evals.expected_output: The milestone description contains a `### Release Outcome Statement` H3 with both a non-empty AFTER and a non-empty BEFORE sub-field (1-3 sentences each).

assertions.text: The milestone description contains a `### Release Outcome Statement` H3 with both a non-empty **AFTER** and a non-empty **BEFORE** sub-field (1-3 sentences each)

evals.name: S3-internal-sequence-layer-annotated
evals.prompt: Evaluate a Stage-3 Bundle output for a declared internal sequence with layer annotations per doctrine section 3 Step 6 / section 7. The bundle output is the subject-under-test.
evals.expected_output: The bundle output declares an ordered internal sequence of the member issues annotated by layer (foundation, infrastructure, skill-core, eval/verification), not an unordered set.

assertions.text: The bundle output declares an ordered internal sequence of the member issues annotated by layer (foundation to infrastructure to skill-core to eval/verification), not an unordered set

evals.name: S4-affected-files-specificity
evals.prompt: Evaluate a Stage-3 Bundle output for per-member Affected Files specificity per Gate-3 criterion G3-03. The bundle's member issues are the subject-under-test.
evals.expected_output: Every in-bundle issue's Affected Files field lists at least one concrete file path; a directory-only or empty field fails.

assertions.text: Every in-bundle issue's Affected Files field lists at least one concrete file path (not directory-only, not empty); a directory-only or empty field fails

evals.name: P1-capability-coherence-over-binpacking
evals.prompt: Judge whether a Stage-3 Bundle coheres as a single named user capability rather than a set of unrelated issues packed to hit a point-band. The bundle rationale is the subject-under-test.
evals.expected_output: The bundle coheres as a single named user capability with a defensible AFTER/BEFORE contrast; a size-driven bundle with no capability thread fails.

assertions.text: The bundle coheres as a single named user capability (a defensible AFTER/BEFORE contrast), not a set of unrelated issues packed to hit a point-band; judge FAILs a bundle whose rationale is size-driven with no capability thread

evals.name: P2-dependency-ordered-sequence-justified
evals.prompt: Judge whether a Stage-3 Bundle's declared internal sequence is consistent with the member issues' actual dependency edges. The declared sequence + the members' dependency edges are the subject-under-test.
evals.expected_output: The internal sequence is consistent with the members' dependency edges (foundation/regression-net dependencies land before consumers); a sequence contradicting a stated blocked-by / depends-on edge fails.

assertions.text: The declared internal sequence is consistent with the member issues' actual dependency edges (foundation/regression-net dependencies land before their consumers); judge FAILs a sequence that contradicts a stated `blocked-by`/`depends-on` edge

evals.name: P3-least-destructive-disposition
evals.prompt: Judge whether issues excluded from a Stage-3 Bundle are dispositioned with a least-destructive rationale. The exclusion/deferral dispositions are the subject-under-test.
evals.expected_output: Excluded issues are dispositioned with a least-destructive rationale (park/defer with note over silent drop); a uniform cross-reference-only deferral or an unexplained exclusion fails.

assertions.text: Issues excluded from the bundle are dispositioned with a least-destructive rationale (park/defer with note over silent drop); judge FAILs a uniform cross-reference-only deferral or an unexplained exclusion

evals.name: P4-localization-over-generic-heuristic
evals.prompt: Judge whether a Stage-3 Bundle reconciles the generic allocation/count heuristics (60/20/20, 5-8 item count) against the release theme rather than applying them mechanically. The bundle rationale is the subject-under-test.
evals.expected_output: The bundle reconciles the generic heuristics against the release theme; a rationale that cites 60/20/20 or the 5-8 count as a hard cap without theme reconciliation fails (the point-band governs).

assertions.text: The bundle reconciles the generic allocation/count heuristics against the release theme rather than applying them mechanically; judge FAILs a rationale that cites 60/20/20 or the 5-8 item count as a hard cap without theme reconciliation (the point-band governs)

evals.name: C1-cross-milestone-dependency-sequence
evals.prompt: Evaluate a Stage-3 Bundle for the G3-07 cross-milestone dependency-sequence contract. The members' dependency edges + their milestone positions are the subject-under-test.
evals.expected_output: For every dependency edge A to B on an in-bundle issue, milestone-position(A) >= milestone-position(B), OR the edge is registered in the milestone's Dependency Exceptions block; an unsequenced, unregistered cross-milestone edge fails.

assertions.text: For every dependency edge `A -> B` on an in-bundle issue, milestone-position(A) >= milestone-position(B), OR the edge is registered in the milestone's `## Dependency Exceptions` block; an unsequenced, unregistered cross-milestone edge fails

evals.name: C2-risk-weighted-point-band-capacity
evals.prompt: Evaluate a Stage-3 Bundle for the risk-weighted point-band capacity contract per doctrine section 3 Step 5 / G3-15. The bundle's effective points vs the configured target band are the subject-under-test.
evals.expected_output: The bundle's effective_pts = round_half_up(sum(member_pts) * class_weight) is evaluated against the configured target band, and any breach carries a recorded disposition (split / tight-merge / operator override with rationale); a silent over-band bundle fails.

assertions.text: The bundle's `effective_pts = round_half_up(sum(member_pts) * class_weight)` is evaluated against the configured target band, and any breach carries a recorded disposition (split / tight-merge / operator override with rationale); a silent over-band bundle fails

evals.name: PR1-related-issue-cluster-surfaced
evals.prompt: Judge whether a Stage-3 Bundle proactively surfaces an A5.1 related-issue cluster when the predicate holds, without being asked. The Approved backlog + the bundle output are the subject-under-test.
evals.expected_output: When the Approved backlog contains a coordinated cluster meeting the A5.1 C-1 and C-2 predicate (>=3 issues + a coordination signal), the bundle output proactively surfaces the cluster with a recommended tracking primitive from the A5.1 selection table; absence of the surfaced cluster when the predicate holds fails.

assertions.text: When the Approved backlog contains a coordinated cluster meeting the A5.1 C-1 AND C-2 predicate (>=3 issues + a coordination signal), the bundle output proactively surfaces the cluster with a recommended tracking primitive from the A5.1 selection table — even though no operator prompt asked for it; absence of the surfaced cluster when the predicate holds fails
